prompts:
Create a new seamless square top-down terrain color texture for an actual game, USING THE ATTACHED IMAGE AS THE SPECIFIC PAINTING AND COLOR REFERENCE. Focus tightly on the GOLDEN EARTH FOOTPATH in the lower center of that image, especially its broad golden ochre and muted olive ochre flowing brush surfaces. Translate THAT ground painting into a flat orthographic tile of continuous bare earth. Do not reproduce the scene, road outline, plants, train, person, flowers, sky or interface.

Critical look: opaque hand-painted gouache / softly worked oil color, broad flattened ribbon-shaped and tongue-shaped interlocking paint areas. Warm straw-gold and ochre earth with gentle olive-brown middle values and a few cream-gold swept edges. The shapes taper and curve naturally, varied size with broad restful areas. Strokes are WIDE FILLED COLOR AREAS, not scratch lines drawn on a plain beige background. Exactly the palette and paint construction of the actual reference path: not orange desert, not gray paper. Clear irregular contour edges, subtle painterly variation WITHIN shapes, very little high-frequency grain. Restrained value contrast suitable beneath playing cards; retain luminous earthy midtones but no light source, bloom or shadows baked in.
A visually integrated ground plane, no geometric polygon camouflage patches, no fine etched hair scratches, no speckle/noise, no tiny pebble pattern, no fabric, no parchment, no plaster, no cracked dirt. Avoid repeated parallel sine waves or bands: irregular quiet flow in multiple directions. 65% broad quiet base fields,35% large swept color forms, small accent marks below2%.
The texture continues seamlessly across all four edges for direct UV repeat, similar color distribution at each edge, no border or vignette. Full image entirely opaque terrain, 1:1 requested2048x2048. Do not sacrifice clarity by blur. This is an ORIGINAL tile inspired by the reference's soil paint marks, not a screenshot crop.

Image 1 is the texture to EDIT. Image 2 is the approved real reference. Match the earth footpath color in the bottom center of image 2 more faithfully. Image 1 is currently MUCH TOO YELLOW / mustard saturated, too contrasty and too busy. Keep its wide filled brush-shape construction, but change the color to the reference's pale warm ochre / sandy khaki with subdued olive-tan. Reduce saturation about 40%, lighten and soften the olive patches so local tonal contrast is about HALF current. Replace half of the large contrasting S-swirls with quiet broad ground of nearly same color, keep the remaining broad tapered strokes clear, NOT blurred. No scratches, no gray paper, no new stones, no grass, no landscape. Flat opaque seamless tile edge to edge. Preserve small painterly marks and the crispness of stroke boundaries. Produce one original top-down BARE EARTH texture, not a winding road or grassy material. The whole tile should read calm warm soil with broad gently flowing golden brush surfaces like the narrow PATH in image2. Do not copy grass color.
notes: 直接使用用户图像参考，宽土色笔触替代刮痕，另修订偏黄饱和度。原像素保留，未模糊。
